dedupe_keys.name: metropole europeenne de lille road datasets

description: Métropole Européenne de Lille : road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Européenne de Lille . Coverage: Métropole Européenne de Lille . The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Voies - Réseau routier; Sens de circulation sur le tronçon routier - MEL; Comptages voirie; Carrefour à feu avec priorité bus. Formats seen: OGC:WFS, OGC:WMS, WWW:LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
